name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.APre4.argsPre
typeText:
∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {n : Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Sized n g →
    ∀ {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.APre4 k g m →
        And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.ArgsPre2 n m) (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.LenPre m)

source.code:
theorem APre4.argsPre {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {n : ℕ} (hn : Sized n g) {m : Mem} (h : APre4 k g m) :
    ArgsPre2 n m ∧ LenPre m := by
  obtain ⟨ha, _, _, hg7, hg8⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, g1, g1', g2, g2'⟩ := ha.bounds
  have hlen := ha.len_le hn
  obtain ⟨_, _, hO1, hO2⟩ := ha.1.1.1.1
  rw [← hg7] at g1 g1' hlen
  rw [← hg8] at g2 g2'
  exact ⟨⟨ha.1.1.1.1.1.ctx, g1, g1', g2, g2', hO1, hO2, hlen⟩, ha.1.1.1.1.1.ctx, g1, by omega, g2, by omega⟩
